A.text: Follow-up after dental trauma is mandatory and includes symptom questioning, clinical and radiographic exams, and pulp sensibility testing.

B.text: Because follow-up is mandatory, an absence of symptoms does not make it optional.

C.text: Pulp sensibility testing is a listed component of follow-up, and clinical examination is also required.

D.text: Radiographic examination is a required component of follow-up and should not be left out.
